method: CSV URLs normalized to GitHub repository roots; primary repository metadata and README retrieved via GitHub API; TypeSafe Jev classified abbreviated metadata/README/file names. cost.note: Successful-call usage returned by API; one initial test call outside this batch is excluded. Retry failures without usage are excluded.
